PRIMARY · SECONDARY · TERTIARY

Three stages.
A connected process.

From primary reduction to final shaping.

PRIMARY CRUSHING

Jaw crusher

PRJC1108

The first crushing stage reduces feed material before it moves through the rest of the plant.

  • Single-toggle jaw crusher
  • Hydraulic closed-side setting adjustment
  • Rigid body construction

SECONDARY CRUSHING

Cone crusher

TEREX 1300

The secondary cone crusher continues material reduction after the primary stage.

  • Cone crushing stage
  • Hydraulic cylinder adjustment
  • Connected to screening and return conveyors

TERTIARY CRUSHING

Vertical shaft impactor

PRVI8250

The VSI stage supports particle shaping and the production of fine materials.

  • Rock-on-rock technology
  • Cubical particle shaping
  • Fine-material production
